sentences.text: Party has filed I.A No. 16608 of 2024 and I.A No. 16609 of 2024, applications for change of the counsel.
Considering the reasons, the aforesaid applications are allowed.

These are the bail applications filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant/Majid and applicant/Begum for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No./FIR No. 84 of 2024, registered at Police Station Nourajabad, District Umariya (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(f), 376(2)(n), 376DA, 342, 506, 34 of IPC and section 5L, 5g R/w 6 and 17 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that the applicants 2 MCRC-20050-2024 have been falsely implicated in the case.
The applicant/Begum is mother of the accused Anees.
She is a woman and no allegation is made against her.
She has been roped with the aid of section 34 of IPC.
It is further submitted that applicant/Majid has not committed any offence of rape.
As per prosecution story itself, Anees and prosecutrix were married.
The DNA report is negative.

In these Majid vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20677445/
1 circumstances, applicants may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the bail application on the ground that allegation of rape is also against the appliant/Majid and it is specifically stated that he committed rape on the prosecutrix.
The prosecutrix is minor aged about 14 years and 4 months.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Considering the fact that investigation is complete and charge has been filed.
DNA report is negative in respect of applicant/Majid and applicant/Begum is a woman
, without commenting on the merits of the case, bail applications filed by the applicants is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicants shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only)each with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for their regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard.
